artworks.title: Protesilaos Advancing from a Ship's Prow (Silver Drachm of Thessalian Thebai)
artworks.description: Thessalian drachm — Protesilaos advancing from a ship's prow, the first ashore who would be first to die.

artworks.title: Coinage of Skione (Founded by Protesilaus)
artworks.description: Skione coinage — the city that claimed Protesilaus as founder, the landing hero turned cult name.

artworks.title: Laodamia Writing (from Ovid's Heroides)
artworks.description: Testard's Heroides — Laodamia writing to the husband who leapt first from the black ships.

artworks.title: Laodamia
artworks.description: Joy's Laodamia — the widow whose grief outlived the first Achaean dead at Troy.

popCulture.title: Protesilaus
popCulture.description: First ashore, first to die — Thetis' warning fulfilled, and Laodamia's grief that outlived the black ships.
